rules.series: Electronic passport book, including the Next Generation Passport
rules.quote: Passport books have a small integrated circuit (or “chip”) in the back cover.
rules.note: Department of State FAQ, archived copy of December 2024, in the answer on the Next Generation Passport. The final rule of 25 October 2005 (70 FR 61553) puts anti-skimming material in the front cover and spine, and a vendor (Signicat ReadID) advises opening the booklet, hence the inside of the back cover as the second place. Disputed: a Keesing infographic puts the Next Generation chip in the data page.
